frame.note: Local metres. +z runs up the Nara from its mouth on the Oka, +x is starboard of it.

provenance.channelWidths: Rosmorrechflot order ZD-496-r appendix 2: Nara 20 m, Oka 30 m guaranteed width.
provenance.depths: ESTIMATED navigation-season depths. The published guarantee is 1.00 m at the Kashira projected level.
provenance.currents: ESTIMATED, scaled from the published mean Nara discharge of 5.5 m3/s.
provenance.hazards: ESTIMATED. No public survey of the basin exists.
provenance.landmarks: Positions from OpenStreetMap; shapes are placeholder massing, not surveyed buildings.
provenance.elevation: Terrain tiles (terrarium, about 30 m source) sampled 2026-09-19 and levelled to the river surface. Not a survey.
provenance.buildings: OpenStreetMap footprints (ODbL) reduced to minimum-area boxes; ESTIMATED heights from building:levels or by type.
provenance.moorings: APPROXIMATE. Traced by eye from Esri World Imagery in September 2026: positions and sizes are read off the picture, vessel types are not established, and laid-up craft move between seasons.

elevation.note: metres above the river surface; row-major, z outer, x inner
